lines: Seat 1 chooses Warbrand: at the end, 1 point per rival tile taken, up to 3.
Bid 4 mana on the Wild tile at (-1, 2) (yields 4).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 4 and keep 5 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Seat 2 chooses Hearthkeeper: at the end, 1 point per Steady tile held, up to 3.
Bid 3 mana on the Steady tile at (-1, 1) (yields 2).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 3 and keep 6 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Seat 1 wins the Wild tile at (-1, 2) (yields 4) for 4 mana.
Seat 3 wins the Shifting tile at (2, -1) (yields 3) for 3 mana.
Seat 2 wins the Steady tile at (-1, 1) (yields 2) for 3 mana.
Bid 2 mana on the Steady tile at (-2, 0) (yields 2).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 2 and keep 4 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
Bid 2 mana on the Steady tile at (-2, 0) (yields 2).
If yours is the only highest bid, you pay 2 and keep 3 mana.
If you're outbid or tied, you pay nothing and get one of the tiles nobody wins, at random.
A tie for the Steady tile at (-2, 0) (yields 2) at 2 mana: nobody gets it.
Seat 1 gets the Wild tile at (0, -2) (yields 1) for free.
Seat 2 gets the Shifting tile at (1, 1) (yields 1) for free.
Seat 3 gets the Steady tile at (-2, 0) (yields 2) for free.
